description: SEC 10-K properties footprint (Item 2) — Physical footprint from a US public company's latest (or earlier, filing 0-4) Form 10-K on SEC EDGAR (Item 2 Properties). Returns the headquarters statement (owned or leased when stated), an owned vs leased mix (MOSTLY_OWNED / MOSTLY_LEASED / MIXED / NOT_STATED), every square-footage figure with its quote and the largest one, facility counts stated in prose (stores, branches, plants, data centers, distribution centers...), facility types present (manufacturing, distribution, retail, office, dataCenter, researchDevelopment, landAndResources), US states and countries named, the adequacy statement, an excerpt, and a depth tier DETAILED / STANDARD / MINIMAL / CROSS_REFERENCED. Table runs are skipped for counts to avoid misreading columns. Params: ticker (e.g. MSFT, or a CIK number); optional filing=0..4 for earlier 10-Ks. Source: SEC EDGAR (public domain). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
